stop_conditions: On any spec/plan conflict, record `Ruling:` and follow the spec. On any unexpected failure, invoke `systematic-debugging` before editing implementation. A low-reasoning executor must not merge, integrate, or push directly to `main`; stop at the high-reasoning merge gate. - [ ] Add failing acceptance assertions for any criterion not already pinned by focused tests. - [ ] Run targeted RED and close gaps in the owning component, not by weakening acceptance. - [ ] Run `npm run validate && npm test && npm run verify:sw`. - [ ] Run `PYTHONPATH=server python3 -m pytest server/tests -q && python3 scripts/browser_smoke.py`. - [ ] Commit `test: add K3 learner evidence acceptance gate`.
